name: reelbolt
description: Connect Claude Code to ReelBolt: the platform assistant's own tools over MCP (projects, files, agents, recipes, workflow authoring and execution, outputs, design system), plus skills for building from recipes, running and watching runs, inspecting results, consent and budget, and the design system. You sign in through your browser; there is no token to paste.

server_url.title: ReelBolt MCP server URL
server_url.description: The address of your ReelBolt MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp. For ReelBolt Cloud use https://reelbolt.ai/mcp; a self-hosted installation uses its own HTTPS domain plus /mcp (plain http is only for a local instance). Claude Code connects here, then opens your browser to sign you in and ask for your approval, so there is no token to create or paste.
